payload.text: hv, 26 Nov 2026, first-hand in vc's session, read by vc's date -u of 10:34Z. hv's words, on the zeopit desk: "I have Music on the last space, where it is now. I just re-ran the Save for zeopit with it in the right spot. Did that work?" vc then asked what 2.15.0 should do about Save, and hv chose: "Fix Save fully now (Recommended)". Its report counts macOS's own windows among those it could not name, so the loss cannot be read from it. vc put zeopit right by hand: the edit of decision 51 with Music's desktop added as main's 8th; hv's saved file is kept as zeopit.hv-saved-1029Z.yaml beside the other backups. In 2.15.0, cc's: discover shows each desktop that holds a window it cannot name, as apply does, records, and shows each display its start desktop again; its report names any running app's window it still could not record. Design first, then ic's read, one bats run, and one live Save by hv. The push and the cut wait for it.
